about: Which uses each face file in this folder is licensed for, as DATA. An app build carries a face only when its licensed_for holds "app" (ios/carry-licensed-faces.sh, a build phase of every Apple target that draws a title, reads this file); otherwise the app draws that role with the system face (LookFaces in ios/Shared/Look.swift, the first family the device has). A face goes into apps by one edit here (a bought licence, or the person's own choice recorded in chosen_by): add the use to licensed_for and keep the receipt named in receipt; no code changes. test/licensed-faces.test.mjs refuses a face file this file does not name and any Apple project that bundles a face file directly.

faces.note: Trillion's own title face, made from Fraunces (The Fraunces Project Authors, SIL Open Font License 1.1) and tuned towards Recoleta: SOFT 75, WONK 0, opsz 48 at weights 330, 450 and 580, side bearings narrowed to Recoleta's fit, the x-height raised to Recoleta's and Recoleta's line height. The OFL lets it be used, changed and carried in apps and pages; its notice travels in each file's name table and in Look-OFL.txt beside them.

The person chose Recoleta and accepted the licence risk himself (2026-10-06); no AI removes it or asks to buy it. The files came from a free-font site; a Latinotype licence or an original Trillion face drawn alike are optional later choices, never a gate. No receipt is in any repository (checked 2026-11-21).

chosen_by.words: The owner picked Recoleta, is fine with the foundry noticing it is used, and accepts the consequences.

faces.licensed_for_checked: The repository holds no Latinotype licence or receipt; the licensed_for list records the owner choice of 2026-10-06 only. Web and PDF (a PDF embeds the face, as deck.pdf does) need a receipt that names each use.

faces.note: Apple's SF Pro licence does not allow embedding the face in websites, so web is taken out (2026-11-21). The files left the kit and no page ships them. The owner's choice of 2026-10-17 keeps the face for video and social; the face stays named here so those uses stay on record. Video and social uses are not checked by the web gate.

chosen_by.words: the person chose this face for their videos, their web app and their public site; their own words are kept in their own records
chosen_by.known_licence_limit: Apple's licence covers designing for Apple platforms; web embedding is no longer used (2026-11-21, web taken out); video and social stay the owner's accepted risk.

web_taken_out.why: Apple's licence does not allow the face in websites.

faces.note: Apple's SF Pro family, used by the overlay tool for labels and citation cards in video. The owner's 2026-10-17 choice names SF Pro Text for videos, not SF Pro Display. No receipt recorded.
Caption style faces in caption-styles.json (three styles). Arial ships with the operating system; its licence terms for embedding in distributed video are not recorded in the repository.
Caption style face in caption-styles.json. The licence file is not in the repository; record the licence file before any use.
